Volutar PT3 player and Peter Sovietov Ayumi AY emulator, MIT licenses in this directory.
Sources copied from https://github.com/Volutar/pt3player at aaa5c321466d955b8a96509216a2e5cbc860d7b3.
Ayumi upstream: https://github.com/true-grue/ayumi.
R&R bridge and freestanding runtime: GPL-3.0. Build using Clang with wasm-ld: ./vendor/pt3/build.sh.
The browser accepts local single-chip PT3 modules only. No third-party music is bundled.
